scope.reviewMethod: Compared PNG SHA-256 hashes by page. Reused the prior visual review for 253 identical pages. Inspected all 161 changed and 3 new pages on 12-page Pillow contact sheets. Zoomed table pages 244, 245, 248, and 249.

repairsVerified.issue: Adjacent architecture table cells previously merged labels and body text.
repairsVerified.evidence: Pages 243 through 249 now show separate cell labels and text in bordered grid tables. Full-resolution review confirmed visible cell boundaries and readable labels.

findings.issue: The semantic retrieval table spans the page break between its two rows. The first row appears at the bottom of page 244 and the second row starts at the top of page 245. No individual row breaks across the page.
findings.impact: The table remains readable, but the reader must turn the page between its rows.
findings.recommendation: Keep the full semantic retrieval table on one page if the layout allows.

blankPages.scope: The final set has 417 page images. All 161 changed pages and 3 new pages were inspected. The remaining 253 pages match the prior inspected render by SHA-256.

missingOrClippedPages.scope: Every page image from 1 through 417 exists. No major body-text clipping was visible on reviewed pages.

oversizedImages.scope: All changed and new pages were inspected on contact sheets. Earlier zoom review covered representative diagrams on pages 26 and 47.

whiteGaps.scope: Some pages end at section boundaries or contain short reference material. The three appended reference pages contain expected source links and no unexplained layout gaps.

tables.detail: Table Grid borders separate each cell. Titles and descriptions remain distinct. No individual row breaks across pages. The semantic retrieval table spans pages 244 and 245 between rows.

pageFlow.detail: The book and question appendix flow across pages. The new question appendix pages are legible. Three appended source-index pages extend the document to page 417.

limits: This review covers rendered appearance only. It does not verify factual accuracy or completeness.
It does not test output from a physical printer.
It does not verify document metadata, EXIF, C2PA, or invisible watermark status.
Fine text review focused on changed pages and stated representative zoom pages.
